items.content:
It isn't that I think it's decipherable. It's that it's the only object I
know where every single person who has looked at it has projected
something different — herbal, astrological, hoax, cipher, glossolalia,
a woman's medical text.

The manuscript is a mirror. Six hundred years of people telling us about
themselves and calling it research.

summary: The undeciphered manuscript as a mirror for every reader's projection
title: On the Voynich manuscript, and why I keep coming back
